title: Bug: missing rpki in frr
author: mjonkers1989
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

When you want to setup rpki in frr you get the error: % Unknown command: rpki
But the command should working when you enable bgpd with rpki
 

### Steps to Reproduce

```
vtysh
conf t
rpki
```

You should configure the rpki part for frr.
instead of unknow command because the command is visible in frr

comments.author: Bojun-Feng
comments.body:
Did some research on the FRR build history.

The `nortrlib` flag was introduced in https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/pull/2454 back in 2019 [in this line](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/pull/2454/changes#diff-52844669b6e7ef29ec5bae13bed2848a857baa14bc650281709b7484db9767dfR16) when FRR was upgraded from 4.0 to 6.0.2. I'm not sure why it was added, maybe due to lack of certain dependencies in build environment? This flag disables RKPI.

Every subsequent FRR upgrade ([PR #2899](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/pull/2899) for 7.0.1, [PR #3575](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/pull/3575) for 7.1, [PR #10691](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/pull/10691) for 8.2, [PR #20269](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/pull/20269) for 10.0.1, [PR #25839](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/pull/25839) for 10.5.1) has carried the flag forward unchanged.

The flag:
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/blob/9dd4a539f083157b5229ef66ccbfd55ce8dfdb9a/src/sonic-frr/Makefile#L55-L59

The FRR source already includes the full RPKI implementation. Happy to take a stab at adding dependencies in build environment and compiling the feature.

comments.author: Bojun-Feng
comments.body:
Wanted to give a quick update on the PR:

Right now CI is all green for the CR, but want to hear people's opinions on which approach makes more sense for rpki.

For now, I added an `INCLUDE_FRR_RPKI` build toggle in `rules/config` (default `y`) that conditionally removes the `-Ppkg.frr.nortrlib` profile from `dpkg-buildpackage`. 

Seems like `build_templates/init_cfg.json.j2` require special reviewer approval. There are some potential alternatives with tradeoffs:
1. Always pass `-M rpki` to bgpd, same as how `-M snmp` is hardcoded in both branches of the `supervisord.conf.j2`. Loading the module only makes RPKI commands available in vtysh; actual validation requires explicit operator configuration (`rpki cache`, route-map `match rpki`, etc.). Not sure if we want every deployment to load this module though.
2. Follow the `frr_bmp` pattern. The tradeoff is feature is not discoverable via `show feature status` until the operator creates the CONFIG_DB entry. Something like:
   - Gate `-M rpki` on `FEATURE.frr_rpki.state == "enabled"` in `supervisord.conf.j2`
   - Add `frr_rpki` to `FEATURE_EXCLUSION_LIST` in `featured` (prevents it from trying to manage a nonexistent systemd service)
   - Add `frr_rpki` skip in `container_checker` (prevents Monit alerts for a nonexistent container)
   - Operators create the FEATURE entry manually and restart the bgp container to activate

Would appreciate thoughts on which approach is preferred, or whether touching `init_cfg.json.j2` is feasible for this change. After we settle on the approach I'm happy to build a VS image and do some sanity checks in GNS3.

linkedPullRequests.title: [frr]: Enable RPKI prefix validation support
linkedPullRequests.author: Bojun-Feng
linkedPullRequests.body:
<!--
     Please make sure you've read and understood our contributing guidelines:
     https://github.com/Azure/SONiC/blob/gh-pages/CONTRIBUTING.md

     ** Make sure all your commits include a signature generated with `git commit -s` **

     If this is a bug fix, make sure your description includes "fixes #xxxx", or
     "closes #xxxx" or "resolves #xxxx"

     Please provide the following information:
-->

#### Why I did it

Fix https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/22389

SONiC builds FRR with `-Ppkg.frr.nortrlib`, which passes `--disable-rpki` to FRR's configure script and suppresses the `frr-rpki-rtrlib` package entirely. This means RPKI prefix validation is unavailable even though FRR's source tree contains the complete implementation. The `nortrlib` flag was introduced in PR #2454 (2019) when FRR was upgraded to 6.0.2, likely due to missing `librtr-dev` in the build environment at the time, and has been carried forward through every subsequent FRR upgrade without re-evaluation. Since Debian 12 (bookworm) ships `librtr-dev` 0.8.0 and the cross-build slave already installs it, the flag is no longer necessary.

##### Work item tracking
- Microsoft ADO **(number only)**:

#### How I did it
* Add `INCLUDE_FRR_RPKI` build toggle in `rules/config` (default `y`) with full build system plumbing (`Makefile.work` passthrough, `slave.mk` export and `$(info)` diagnostic)
* Conditionally remove the `nortrlib` profile, register the `frr-rpki-rtrlib` .deb package, and install it in `docker-fpm-frr`
* Register `frr_rpki` FEATURE in `init_cfg.json.j2` (default state `disabled`) and add FEATURE-gated `-M rpki` module loading in bgpd's supervisord config with correct `and`/`or` parenthesization
* Skip `frr_rpki` in container health checkers (same pattern as `frr_bmp`)

#### How to verify it
1. Build with default config and verify `frr-rpki-rtrlib_*.deb` is produced and installed in `docker-fpm-frr`
2. Set `INCLUDE_FRR_RPKI = n` in `rules/config` and verify the build reverts to the original behavior (no RPKI package)
3. On a running image, enable via `config feature state frr_rpki enabled`, restart bgp container, and confirm `rpki` command is available in vtysh
